title: Pakistan Marks First Anniversary of 'Marka-e-Haq' With Nationwide Military Celebrations
detail: Pakistan officially commemorated the first anniversary of 'Marka-e-Haq' (Battle of Truth) — the government's name for Pakistan's May 2025 military response to India — with nationwide ceremonies, concerts at Lahore's Liberty Roundabout, a special ISPR documentary release, and coordinated events at Pakistani diplomatic missions worldwide. Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz attended major events alongside senior military commanders. Field Marshal Asim Munir chaired the 275th Corps Commanders Conference, praising national unity and operational preparedness. The commemoration reflected the military's elevated domestic prestige following the 2025 conflict and the 27th Constitutional Amendment that gave Munir Field Marshal rank and expanded command authority.

media.caption: Pakistan marks Marka-e-Haq first anniversary with nationwide military celebrations
